name: progressbar-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is progressbar2 (`progressbar`), a Python library that renders text progress bars. A
`ProgressBar` is assembled from widgets (percentages, counters, timers, ETAs, transfer speeds, fill bars and markers)
and decides when to redraw through an update gate; the package also detects terminal and colour support from the
environment, renders colours and gradients as ANSI escape sequences, manages several bars at once with `MultiBar`,
wraps iterables through `progressbar.progressbar()` with a lean fast renderer, redirects stdout/stderr above a
running bar, and ships a `pv`-like `progressbar` command-line tool.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every module of the progressbar package except: the parallel helpers under
progressbar/_parallel/, the version module progressbar/__about__.py, the generated colour table
progressbar/terminal/colors.py and the Windows console module progressbar/terminal/os_specific/windows.py.
The documentation in scope is: README.md, docs/index.rst, every page under docs/explanation/, docs/tutorial/ and
docs/widgets/, every page under docs/howto/ except docs/howto/parallel-execution.rst, the four reference pages
docs/reference/index.rst, docs/reference/progressbar.rst, docs/reference/multibar.rst and docs/reference/cli.rst, and
the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope Python modules.
